# Pausen — Android App & APK

> Pausen is a quiet, privacy-first Android application and APK for scheduled bedtime curfews, breathing scroll pauses, and warm reading mode. 100% on-device, zero ads, zero trackers, no accounts, and no internet permission.

## Quick Overview
- Application: Pausen
- Release: v1.10.2 (Code 8)
- File: Pausen-1.10.2.apk (3.7 MB / 3,681,980 bytes)
- Target OS: Android 10 (API 29) and newer (compatible with Android 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15+)
- SHA-256 Checksum: 05d24758639b4f58b31db3fafffef73840f8e5d8c7408d07618b8c3e3a5cf038
- Developer: Approxy-dev (https://github.com/approxy-dev)
- Repository: https://github.com/approxy-dev/Pausen-App
- Download: https://github.com/approxy-dev/Pausen-App/releases/download/v1.10.2/Pausen-1.10.2.apk

## Core Capabilities
- **Bedtime Plans:** Scheduled evening wind-down, bedtime curfew, and morning unlock.
- **Scroll Pauses:** Box breathing breaks (4s in, 2s hold, 6s out) with an optional 24-hour commitment lock to interrupt endless social feed scrolling (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube).
- **Warm Reading Tint:** Softer evening screen tint without blue light.
- **Zero Internet Requirement:** The Android manifest omits the `INTERNET` permission completely. All settings, logs, and schedules stay strictly in on-device SQLite storage.
- **Anti-Distraction Commitment:** Background protection, clock-change defense, and Settings and uninstall guard support during protected hours.

## Installation Instructions
1. Download `Pausen-1.10.2.apk` directly to your Android device.
2. In Downloads, tap the file. When prompted, enable "Allow from this source" for your browser or file manager.
3. Review Play Protect scans and complete installation.
4. Launch Pausen and follow on-screen setup to grant Accessibility and background access.
